note: Lead announcements for the Tuesday Brevo digest (netlify/functions/digest-prepare.mjs). An entry runs as the email's lead section, and its subject becomes the email subject, when the send date (the Tuesday, YYYY-MM-DD, UTC) falls between from and until, inclusive. Plain text only: everything is HTML-escaped. Never quote a rate or leverage here unless it matches data/rates.json, and never name an investor or capital partner.

announcements.headline: Now offering: commercial real estate loans
announcements.subject: Now offering: commercial real estate loans
announcements.intro: The lender you already use for rentals, flips and ground-up builds now finances commercial property too. Two new products:

points.text: Short-term financing to buy, reposition or refinance a commercial property, reviewed case by case.
Long-term financing qualified on the property's income, with 5-year hybrid and 15, 25 and 30-year fixed options.
For investors and owner-occupied commercial property.
multi-family, mixed-use, retail, office, industrial and warehouse, self-storage, mobile home parks and more.

announcements.how: How it works: send us the scenario. It takes about two minutes and there's no credit pull. Our commercial team replies by email, usually within one business day.
announcements.partners: Brokers and referral partners: you can send commercial scenarios too. Brokers, from the Broker Portal. Referral partners, from your own page.
